title: Path Traversal
description: Path traversal occurs when an externally influenced path is not constrained to an intended directory, allowing access to files outside that boundary.
indicators: user input joined to a filesystem path
checks that only remove traversal substrings
file operations before canonical path containment is verified
prevention: Resolve and canonicalize paths before use, then verify the result remains within the allowed root.
Prefer server-side identifiers mapped to known files over accepting arbitrary paths.
Apply access controls to files and directories.
source: MITRE CWE-22 (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/22.html); OWASP Top 10:2025 A01 Broken Access Control (https://top10.owasp.org/2025/A01_2025-Broken_Access_Control/)
